QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] The One Who Walks Down Memory Lane 1
QuestInfo.0: I went inside the temple through the broken Door to the Past, but I kept circling back to the same place.  This Temple of Time...I can't go forward unless I get permission from the Goddess.  How do I get permission from the Goddess?  I should ask #b#p2140000##k.
QuestInfo.1: You were told that the Goddess is in eternal sleep, and you need permission from the #p2140000# to get through Road to the Past. He promises to grant you that permission if you agree to #binvestigate the break-in.\n\nWhen you agree, #p2140000# proposes a #btest#k. You must defeat #r50#k #r#o8200001#s#k in #m270010100#.
QuestInfo.2: #p2140000# granted you permission, and you were allowed to go further. However...

0.0: You want to receive permission from the Goddess? Rhinne is in a deep sleep so you cannot meet her at the moment. But, there is another way. As the manager of this temple, I can grant you permission on behalf of her.
0.1: This works out perfectly. I have an offer. Since you seem like a powerful adventurer, how about you promise to #binvestigate the intrusion#k that happened recently? If you agree to do so, I will give you permission to explore the temple. What do you say? Deal?

yes.0: That was a wise choice. But first, I'll need to #btest#k your strength. Even if you are given permission to enter the temple, it would be useless unless your skills hold up. #bIn order to counter the flow of the past, you need a certain amount of strength#k.
yes.1: The test is simple. Go to #b#m270010100##k, the only area that you're allowed in right now, and defeat #o8200001#s. If you can defeat #r50#k of them, I will grant you permission to go in further.

no.0: It's too hard? That's too bad. Thank you for visiting the Temple of Time. I'm sure Rhinne would have been very pleased. Goodbye.

1.0: I did not expect you to do that at all. Permission granted!

yes.0: #dAs the representative of Rhinne, the Goddess of Time, I grant you permission to look back at your 2nd memory.#k

mob.0: You haven't defeated those #r50 #o8200001#s#k. I don't think you're strong enough to walk against the flow of time yet.
